crossRefs.note: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

translations.web: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
translations.bsb: The slacker does not plow in season; at harvest time he looks, but nothing is there.
translations.kjv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest,
translations.asv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; Therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.
